name: weave-desktop
description: Weave USB and Bluetooth desktop companion

scripts.dev: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "vite renderer --config renderer/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: vite build renderer --config renderer/vite.config.ts && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
scripts.pack:windows: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never
scripts.pack:macos: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
